main.description: Pro Top International is a Hong Kong-based sourcing and supply chain company specialising in personal care electrical appliances.
main.tagline: Global sourcing & supply chain solutions from Hong Kong

profile.title: Company Profile
profile.text1: Pro Top is a Hong Kong-based company offering global sourcing and supply chain solutions to customers worldwide. With strong experience in customs clearance and government commodity inspections, Pro Top is equipped with exceptional logistics fundamentals and a notable trading history.
profile.text2: A branch office in Dongguan enables efficient transportation between Hong Kong and China at the lowest costs. Supplied goods include, but are not limited to, Health & Personal Care and Electrical & Electronics.

highlights.title: Hong Kong & Dongguan
highlights.text: Headquartered in Hong Kong with a branch office in Dongguan.

highlights.title: Customs & Inspection
highlights.text: Experienced in customs clearance and government commodity inspections.

highlights.title: Efficient Logistics
highlights.text: Cost-effective transportation between Hong Kong and China.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: We aim to be the connection that bridges imagination with reality — realising the creativity of our customers and bringing it to life, by supplying products of the highest quality and maintaining excellent service.

products.intro: Over years of operation, we have sourced and manufactured a wide range of personal care products for international brand owners, specialising in electrical hair appliances.
